covers: a source component with props becomes a component set with matching variant axes and a text property
prompt: Add the Button from {FIXTURE}/components.jsx (styles in {FIXTURE}/components.css) to {FILE_URL} as a Figma component, on the page "{PAGE}"

saturated.setFound: any component set counts, button-named or not
saturated.colorMatch: checked only on the variants that exist, so two of four variants still score 1
saturated.sizingShare: counts a child as sized when either axis is not FIXED; text layers hug by default
saturated.constrainedAbsShare: a button has no absolute children, so the share is vacuously 1
